sources.title: Kanha-AI (Kanha AI) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Kanha.ai specializes in training custom chatbots and providing an innovative SDK that allows these chatbots to run directly on client devices. This groundbreaking approach eliminates the need for constant API calls to remote servers, significantly reducing operational costs and enhancing performance.

sources.title: GitHub - Kanha-AI/Kanha-AI
sources.snippet: Crawl — Point Kanha at your site. We index your pages, handling JavaScript-rendered content automatically. Train — We generate question-answer pairs from your content and fine-tune a compact model tailored to your site. Deploy — Drop in a script tag, Web Component, or React component. The model loads and runs on-device via WebGPU.

sources.title: Kanha AI - Voice-First Child Companion
sources.snippet: Kanha AI is a safe, screen-free voice-first AI companion for children, inspired by the spirit of Krishna. It encourages curiosity, healthy routines and emotional growth while parents stay in control.
